focus.name: GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER
focus.purpose: Close the direct reader/writer and increment-call closure without assigning an unproven user-facing resource meaning.

writers.name: Game_InitializeDifficultyCounter
writers.effect: Initializes the ASCII counter to '5', '3', or '2' from GAME_DIFFICULTY_MODE.

writers.name: Game_IncrementDifficultyCounter
writers.effect: Increments and clamps the ASCII counter at '9', optionally queuing audio command 0x66.

writers.name: Level_ExitAndTerminalTransition
writers.effect: Decrements the counter during the gated terminal-transition path.

direct_readers.name: Render_BuildActorRecords
direct_readers.effect: Converts the ASCII digit into the seeded HUD actor tile.

direct_readers.name: ActorType7E_PlayerCollisionHandler
direct_readers.effect: Uses '9' as the terminal scene-resource branch after the secondary-counter transition tests.

direct_readers.name: ActorType46_PlayerCollisionHandler
direct_readers.effect: Tests the cap before invoking Game_IncrementDifficultyCounter and collision-template reinitialization.

direct_readers.name: LevelEvent_SpawnType46WhenSceneReady
direct_readers.effect: Suppresses the shared Type-0x46 spawn when the counter is already '9'.

direct_readers.name: InteractionGate_Type46_AF
direct_readers.effect: Suppresses the selector-0xAF shared Type-0x46 spawn when the counter is already '9'.

direct_readers.name: LevelEvent_SpawnType46WhenModeReady
direct_readers.effect: Suppresses the mode-ready shared Type-0x46 spawn when the counter is already '9'.

limitations: The closure establishes the counter's initialization, progression, display, cap, and transition roles.
No user-facing name such as lives, wishes, score, or inventory quantity is assigned.
evidence: Cached Ghidra decompilation of every listed function
